pr_title: Bluetooth: controller: Add conn creation param checks
pr_body:
Coverity detected that a zero divisor can be passed to
ll_create_connection() without parameter sanitization. Conditionally
check the connection creation parameters according to spec.

Fixes #35343.

Signed-off-by: Carles Cufi <carles.cufi@nordicsemi.no>

review_comments: Should check conn_interval_min as well, even though it isn't used by the controller.
Since it is not used at all by the controller I thought it was not worth it to be honest. At that point there is no risk of providing the controller with invalid data.

Sure, no big deal, I just thought it would be more maintainable in case you change that to use the conn_interval_min instead, then you would have to update in this place. And also in case there is some conformance testing.
